analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. It adds one table row at head line 1389 documenting `decodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks`: 4 for the Qwen 3.5 family (including Qwen35MoEModel) and 0 otherwise, in `EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift` (`qwenDecodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks`). The change is documentation-only; no code, keys, wire protocol, encryption, attestation or authorization behavior changes in the supplied evidence. I reviewed both base text units (lines 806-1611). They cover GLM serving, deadlines and calibration, prefix-cache/SSD references, and the scheduler table.

Security relevance is limited to availability and scheduling (T-010 and T-029 are tangentially related). The doc describes holding prompt chunks so decode-only steps interleave, which is the same mechanism already described for GLM (default 8). The deadline projection already charges held steps, so first-content deadline admission should stay consistent. The corresponding code change (`qwenDecodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks`) is not in the supplied evidence. The next pass should confirm that it exists and is bounded, that it takes part in the complete-checkpoint numerics fingerprint or the profile-qualification environment checks if it is configurable, and that the deadline-projection and prefix-cache scheduling interactions hold for Qwen. The doc does not claim an environment override, so no new configuration surface is evident. T-041 (prefix cache) is untouched: no TTL, scope or lookup-key changes. No security regression or threat-model invalidation is identified from this documentation row. Whether the real implementation matches the documented behavior is unverified.
